title: Grid pressure briefing
subtitle: National Electricity Market
time_note: Clock times are NEM time: Australian Eastern Standard Time, UTC+10, with no shift for daylight saving. During daylight saving that is one hour behind Melbourne and Sydney clocks.

tabs.meaning: The tightest wholesale prices in the last 90 days were in New South Wales. From 4pm to 9pm the average wholesale price across the states was $86.32 per megawatt-hour. From 10am to 2pm it was $21.64. Evening power has been clearly dearer than the middle of the day. Household electricity prices rose 10.6% over the year to the September quarter 2026, faster than the 3.9% rise in overall prices. That is the pressure households feel. It is not a measure of any single data centre.

tabs.meaning: The highest state demand in this briefing was 13,159 MW in New South Wales at 1 Jul 2025, 5:50pm NEM time. Victoria shows the largest change in its typical daily peak versus the same 90 days a year earlier: +3.0%. A new always-on load would lift the overnight floor as well as the evening peak. These public totals cannot show how much of today's floor is already data centres.

tabs.meaning: Over the year to the September quarter 2026, electricity in the consumer price index rose 10.6%. Overall consumer prices rose 3.9%. The cash rate target was 4.85% on 5 Nov 2026. Households are living with both. Wholesale spikes do not pass into bills one-for-one, but a year of dearer electricity already has.

tabs.meaning: Ministers and the regulator: the wholesale heat in the last 90 days is sharpest in New South Wales. That is the first place to test whether new always-on load can be shifted, interrupted, or paired with new supply. There is also a surplus signal in South Australia, which had 6,760 five-minute prices below zero. Daytime flexibility is worth more there than a flat around-the-clock load. From 4pm to 9pm the average wholesale price across the states was $86.32 per megawatt-hour. From 10am to 2pm it was $21.64. Evening power has been clearly dearer than the middle of the day. Households: electricity prices rose 10.6% over the year to the September quarter 2026, against 3.9% for prices overall. The cash rate target is 4.85%. It moved from 4.60% on 4 Nov 2026. Using less power between 4pm and 9pm is the step that lines up with the dearer part of the wholesale day. Do not read any of these totals as the output of a named data centre. The market does not publish that split.
